title: LLM4VV: Evaluating Cutting-Edge LLMs for Generation and Evaluation of Directive-Based Parallel Programming Model Compiler Tests

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a 'Normalized Bias' metric to measure the LLM's tendency to disproportionately predict compiler tests as valid or invalid, determined by evaluating the ratio of false positives to false negatives ((FP - FN) / (FP + FN)).
